annotations.title: Transcribe an audio or video file (Whisper large-v3-turbo)

description: Transcribes the speech in one public audio or video file (direct https link to mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, mp4, mov, webm and other FFmpeg formats) to plain text with the larger Whisper large-v3-turbo model; the language is detected. Use it when transcript accuracy matters: names, accents, noisy or multi-speaker audio. Use job_transcribe instead for clean speech at a lower price per minute. Use job_youtube_transcript instead for a YouTube video that has captions (cheaper). Cost: $0.1003 per started audio minute, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

max_results.description: Most started audio minutes to return and pay for (default 10, at most 120); the run stops there.

media_url.description: Direct https link to the audio or video file (not a web page that embeds it).

name: job_transcribe_premium

items.description: {url, status (ok; partial = stopped at max_results minutes; failed = not media, free), language, durationSeconds, text}

status.description: ok; partial = stopped at max_results minutes; failed = not media, free

usable.description: rows that carry data (only these are charged)
